description: This source file implements the LoggerNDC class which manages nested diagnostic contexts (NDCs) for threading logging purposes. It provides methods for pushing, popping, peeking, and clearing context messages, as well as setting a maximum depth, and it maintains the thread-specific NDC stacks.

classes.name: LoggerNDC
classes.description: Class that manages nested diagnostic contexts (NDC) for logging, allowing context messages to be pushed, popped, peeked, and cleared on a per-thread basis.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all nested diagnostic information for the current thread.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the current NDC stack for the thread.

methods.name: getDepth
methods.description: Returns the current nesting depth of the NDC stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the innermost context message from the NDC stack.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Returns (without removing) the last context message in the NDC stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes a new context message onto the NDC stack for the current thread.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes all diagnostic context information for the thread.

methods.name: setMaxDepth
methods.description: Sets the maximum depth of the NDC stack, truncating if the current depth exceeds this value.
